comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable mekanism items (plus vanilla items ProjectE's defaults leave unvalued, which its recipes need) and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

mekanism_fill_hydrogen_bucket.comment: This chemical is made from water, and a water bucket is worth only its empty bucket, so filling one costs the bucket.

mekanism_fill_nutritional_paste_bucket.comment: The nutritional liquifier makes 50 mB per food point, so a 1,000 mB bucket holds twenty points and drinking it returns the empty bucket. Dried kelp restores one point and is the cheapest food on both ProjectE and Item Alchemy (1 EMC), so the paste costs twenty kelp plus the bucket.

mekanism_hydrogen_chloride_bucket.comment: One salt becomes 2 mB of hydrogen chloride. Salt is evaporated from water, which has no EMC, so a bucket costs the empty bucket.

mekanism_hydrofluoric_acid_bucket.comment: Dissolving one fluorite gem yields 1,000 mB of hydrofluoric acid, so a bucket is one gem and the bucket. The millibucket of sulfuric acid is a catalyst.

mekanism_uranium_hexafluoride_bucket.comment: One millibucket of hydrofluoric acid and one of uranium oxide make two of uranium hexafluoride, so two buckets cost one of each input bucket.

mekanism_dirty_netherite_scrap_from_scra.comment: Enriching one dirty netherite scrap yields one scrap. The crusher's three-scrap debris recipe is the fortune-style bonus and is not the conversion.

mekanism_ore_chain_dirty_from_dust.comment: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

mekanism_ore_chain_clump_from_dirty.comment: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

mekanism_ore_chain_shard_from_clump.comment: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

mekanism_ore_chain_crystal_from_shard.comment: Each ore-processing step turns one of these into one of the next, so the earlier form costs the same as the dust. The doubled ore and raw-ore recipes are not conversions.

mekanism_sulfur_dioxide_bucket.comment: Oxidizing one sulfur dust yields 100 mB of sulfur dioxide, so a bucket is ten dust and the bucket.

mekanism_sulfuric_acid_bucket.comment: Oxidizing one sulfur dust yields 100 mB of sulfur dioxide, two of that plus free oxygen make two sulfur trioxide, and one trioxide plus free water vapor makes one sulfuric acid. A bucket is ten dust, the same as sulfur dioxide. The gas conversion of one dust into 2 mB is the expensive path and is not the cost.

mekanism_sulfur_trioxide_bucket.comment: Two sulfur dioxide and one oxygen make two sulfur trioxide, so a bucket of trioxide costs the dioxide in a bucket.

mekanism_uranium_oxide_bucket.comment: Oxidizing one yellow cake yields 250 mB of uranium oxide, so a bucket is four yellow cake and the bucket.
